content: {"like":["Enjoys epic sci‑fi epics with strong visual design and detailed world‑building (e.g., Dune, Blade Runner).","Values high‑quality action and emotional pacing in contemporary sci‑fi thrillers (e.g., Elysium).","Appreciates live music performances that showcase powerful stage presence and sound production (e.g., One Mile High).","Prefers historically grounded war dramas with intense battle sequences and sharp dialogue (e.g., Fury).","Loves gothic horror series with well‑crafted character interactions and production polish (e.g., Penny Dreadful)."],"dislike":["Dislikes poorly delivered narration that drags the pacing (e.g., Dune).","Finds criticism of a film or show off‑balance when it ignores personal enjoyment (e.g., Elysium).","Criticizes subpar camera work and lighting that detract from performance focus (e.g., One Mile High).","Is bothered by missing expected extra content in special editions (e.g., Blade Runner).","Dislikes lack of social media buzz for a series that otherwise meets production standards (e.g., Penny Dreadful)."]}
